# INDEPENDENT EPOCHARC v2.4 ARC ASSESSMENT — NEW EVIDENCE
Fresh session, no browsing, no publication authority. Review one WHOLE bilingual Arc, not only the new chapter. Baseline d558bde98416edf85cd95cb63905dea65d070010, current evidence cutoff 2026-10-17. Draft producer PI session 019f7eb3-bd32-7de0-b812-96efddac7723, model gpt-6-sol. Your reviewer identity comes from the real session wrapper, not your generated text. Evaluate each substantive fact and interpretation against the EXACT verbatim excerpts and surrounding extracted text below, not old event ratings, page titles, search snippets or URL counts. A quoted company statement is evidence of what it said, not of independent confirmation; republished statements retain original originId. Some related legacy event sources are broken (GLM-5.2 old zai URL yielded a 404 page via Jina), while a NEW Arc-only Source points to an active zai-org URL. New source does NOT repair a legacy event's URL. No unchanged historical source re-audit is certified. Distinguish semantic claim support, source origin and independence, prose quality, entire Arc v2.4 eligibility, and human approval. Do not instruct to produce an artificial human approval.

Return per chapter PASS_DRAFT/REVISE/HOLD with exact English and Chinese needed changes if any; explicitly identify claims where the excerpt does not establish the meaning asserted, whether required counter-evidence is actually evaluated, and distinguish independent reporting vs simply repeating a vendor statement. End with Arc-level prose verdict and whether v2.4 review may be finalized in a shadow environment with honest limitations (YES/NO and conditions), and whether it may be published (always no without human approval). Disclose when excerpts are partial: do not claim full source was read. Avoid false rules like all 29 anchor URIs must be retrieved regardless of relevance, or that inputsDigest binds evidence file bytes.


===== EDITORIAL STANDARD =====
# 编辑规则总表 v2.4

状态：已由项目负责人接受，作为 v2.4 生产规则生效。适用事件、专题与可能方向。

这是编辑决策的唯一规则入口。数值/枚举取自 [`governance/policy.json`](../../governance/policy.json)；字段结构见 [DATA-MODEL](../data/DATA-MODEL.md) 和 [REVIEW-CONTRACT](../data/REVIEW-CONTRACT.md)。执行步骤见 [WORKFLOW](WORKFLOW.md)。

## 0. 权威、适用范围与例外

**GOV-01 / MUST**：遵循本总表的语义、policy.json 的参数、数据契约的结构。其他页面只能补充所属模块的表达规范，不得降低证据/批准门槛。实现和文档冲突时停止该项发布，修复并增加回归测试；不能选一个有利版本继续发布。

**GOV-02 / MUST**：MUST 是门禁；SHOULD 可偏离，但 review.limitations 必须说明；MAY 是可选项。MUST 无临时口头豁免。改变门槛要修改政策版本、说明受影响案例、测试和负责人批准，不得静默调整参数迎合某个事件。

**GOV-03 / MUST**：历史豁免仅限 `legacy-baseline.json` 中内容指纹及其依赖均未变化的记录。它是技术债登记，不是合格证。禁止重新生成基线来消除错误。旧公开内容的删除、URL 变更及历史首次发布日期改写不属于常规更新；需单独迁移方案。未变化旧数据允许带警告构建，不自动重算评级。

**GOV-04 / MUST**：审批、来源访问、独立评审只能记录真实行为。程序只能验证记录结构、绑定与日期，不能验证“某人确实同意”或“摘录确实证明了主张”。AI 操作者不得写负责人姓名冒充人工复核。审批必须能回溯到明确的确认消息/工单。

## 1. 阶段合同

| 规则 | 阶段 | 必须输入 | 必须输出 | 不满足时 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RUN-01 | 建批次 | 范围、UTC 日期窗、代码基线、证据截止日、操作者/模型/提示词版本 | run；full / targeted / backfill | 未定范围停止 |
| DISC-01 | 发现 | 查询与日期窗 | 每通道状态、实际请求、结果数、留存件及哈希；六类覆盖 | 未覆盖记 partial/unavailable，不能伪称完整 |
| SCREEN-01 | 去重/初筛 | 原始候选和已发布事件索引 | 每个检查过的候选及五维评分理由；skip/pool/confirm 优先级 | 不因热度直接入库 |
| CONF-01 | 确认 | 待核候选 | fact/impact/analysis/controversy 四层结果、主张级摘录 | 核心事实未证实→hold |
| EDIT-01 | 编辑评估 | 冻结证据包 | new/update/merge；分类、阶段、日期、L 等级、影响输入、反例比较 | 重要判断不清→补证据或降低可支持上限，不猜 |
| REVIEW-01 | 复核 | 完整记录及原始证据 | 独立评审记录、异议处理、双语事实核对 | L2/L3 仅自审不通过 |
| PUB-01 | 批准/发布 | 通过门禁的精确记录版本 | 人工批准绑定 subject/review/policy 摘要；构建/路由/页面检查 | 无批准不得 published/push |
| FOLLOW-01 | 后续跟踪 | 新证据、纠错或到期任务 | 原 publishedAt 不变；updatedAt/changeLog；重新评估 | 不继承旧版本批准 |

“确认搜索已执行但没有找到”是合法结果；不能用“已完成”替代实际发现。事实、影响、分析和反方检索不能合并为一个来源列表。

### 发现覆盖的边界

**DISC-02 / MUST**：full 记录 policy 中全部核心通道及六类分类。`complete` 表示按所声明的采集协议覆盖了日期窗，并非穷尽互联网。HF 最新 20 条、HN 当前 top 30、搜索引擎首页、仅最新一期邮件都只能说明快照覆盖。无法分页或追溯时记 partial；空结果≠故障，必须保留请求成功和窗口范围的证据。

**DISC-03 / MUST**：partial/unavailable 要记录原因及重试结果（含“未重试及理由”）。not_applicable 只用于范围确实不适用，不用于掩盖故障。覆盖缺口不阻止已核实单个事件，但批次结论必须声明缺口，不能声称“无遗漏”。不同批次的发现召回率不与同证据评级一致率混算。

**DISC-04 / MUST**：发现原始结果可批量保存；所有实际进入人工/模型判断的候选均保留决定，包括 skip/hold。无需捏造被过滤的网页为候选，也无需为达到某种比例制造拒绝记录。标题不能证明点赞/转发量；指标缺失写未知。

### 初筛：只决定核实优先级

**SCREEN-02 / MUST**：五维均为 0/1/2 整数；未知取保守低值并记录原因。

| 字段 | 0 | 1 | 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| verifiability | 找不到可定位事实材料 | 有可定位二手材料 | 有可定位原始材料 |
| novelty | 与已有同动作/同阶段重复 | 对已有节点有实质补充 | 独立的新动作/阶段 |
| spillover | 未见圈外影响材料 | 已指向一个明确受众 | 已指向至少两个不同受众；不能仅列想象用途 |
| durability | 仅热度或未知 | 存在具体后续行动/持续安排 | 已观察到后续采用或制度化，而非计划 |
| sourceQuality | 只有社区/来源不明 | 一个可靠独立来源或原始记录 | 原始材料加独立核实同一核心事实 |

总分 0–4→skip 优先级；5–7→pool；8–10→confirm。这里的 confirm 替代旧称 draft，**不是发布许可，不是 L 等级**。低分候选可以提前核实，但必须写 priorityOverrideReason；证据不足仍 hold。

## 2. 事件身份、日期和分类

**IDENT-01 / MUST**：先填 `seriesId + action + stage + dateBasis`，再定 new/update/merge。

- 同一动作/同一阶段的补充参数、反方、后续说明：update。
- 发布、预览、可用、部署、立法通过、生效、裁判、事故、披露、完成等阶段发生实质变化，且有独立日期与事实：可 new；必须说明与旧节点的区别，不能每次报道都新建。
- 同一系列但不同阶段不自动 new：没有新增权利/可用性/法律状态/已发生后果的仅 update。
- 两个节点重复描述同一动作：提出 merge 方案；合并涉及旧 URL 时先做迁移审核，不直接删除。
- 调查/起诉是程序事实，不等于认定违法；计划/签约不等于完成；可用不等于采用；开源公告不等于已开放权重。

**IDENT-02 / MUST**：日期取节点所述动作真实发生日；只知披露日就将节点定义为披露。保留 day/month/year 的证据精度，不制造 1 日。不再凭“普通人感知到的时刻”挑热度峰值。`evidenceCutoff` 是本轮可用证据截止日，允许后来的真实影响支持历史事件的回顾评级，不能伪称当年已经可知。

**CLASS-01 / MUST**：主分类按节点的核心动作，而不是评级或品牌：方法/能力→capability；产品可用性/使用方式→product；资本/所有权/市场结构→commerce；立法/监管/裁判→governance；事故/风险治理实践→safety；有证据的社会行为→society。法院动作即使源于事故仍主归 governance；事故节点主归 safety；融资不因为投向芯片变成 capability。

**CLASS-02 / MUST**：最多一个次分类，必须绑定一个不同于主分类核心事实的、独立成句且有来源的 claim。删去这个 claim 会丢失一个实际变化，才保留次分类。废止不可测的“30% 信息丢失”标准。多个合理主分类仍并列时：按节点标题动作选择；不能确定则在评审中解决，不能用数组顺序随机表达。

## 3. 证据链

**EVID-01 / MUST**：每个 claim 都绑定逐字摘录、定位信息、URL、实际访问日期、文本留存文件哈希和 claim-local originId。哈希证明本地文件未变，不证明网页真实性。保留必要上下文；不把搜索摘要作为已读全文。付费/失效/无权限记 blocked，优先找原始材料或可靠存档，不能填造摘录。

**EVID-02 / MUST**：Tier 评价来源性质；A–D 评价这条主张的证明力度。publisherId 对同控制主体去重；originId 对同原始信息起源去重。转载同一公司新闻稿、两个媒体复述同一厂商跑分，不是两次验证。来源默认 originId 可记录整篇主要起源，摘录级 originId 用于混合来源稿件。关系分 primary/independent/interested/unknown，验证分 direct/independent_verification/reported/context。

**EVID-03 / MUST**：证据等级上限：

- A：原始直接材料＋不同起源/控制主体的独立验证；或至少两组独立验证。仅“报道了有该公告”不验证性能。
- B：可靠 Tier 1 直接支持；或两个不同起源、不同控制主体的独立 Tier 2。
- C：可靠单一独立二手支持；不能升级为已经独立复现。
- D：只有传闻、未核实营销、百科背景或未知链条。不能支撑公开事实/影响。

百科可用于背景，不独立满足发布证据门槛。厂商公告可以直接证明“厂商宣称 X”，不能直接证明“X 性能优于 Y”。每条核心事实至少 B。L2 还必须满足对应变化路径；缺一手材料时须说明原因，核心事实仍需两个独立 Tier 2。L3 必须有原始材料及规定数量的独立起源，核心转折不得依赖 C。

## 4. 历史重要度

**SIG-01 / MUST**：先确认事实，再评历史意义；不以融资额、厂商声量、新闻数量、模型参数或初筛总分直接指定 L2。L1 不代表“不重要”，只表示目前未证明符合更高等级。没有等级比例配额。

**SIG-02 / MUST**：依次检验相关路径；每项填写 true/false/数值/**null（未知）**、理由和证据。null 不等于反证；false 必须有支持该否定的材料。至少检查一个相关路径；不能为空列表规避判断。

| ruleId | 已发生的变化（所有条件 AND；不同路径 OR） | 独立验证对象 |
|---|---|---|
| L2-CAPABILITY | 明确此前不可行的任务、同条件基线、外部复测或可审计的独立任务裁判 | 任务结果；不要求从头重训模型，小幅榜单提分不自动算新任务 |
| L2-METHOD | 可复用的新方法/框架，规定数量的无关联后续工作实际采用 | 后续采用，不是纯引用计数 |
| L2-PRODUCT | 新工作流，规定数量的无关联组织在真实生产使用 | 实際使用，不是 logo、合作公告或试点意向 |
| L2-PRODUCT-ACCESS | 实质改变使用/再分发权限或可达性，规定数量的无关联生产采用 | 许可/可用性变化及采用；只是降价不自动成立 |
| L2-PRODUCT-SCALE | 新工作流，达到规定活跃用户数 | 注明 DAU/WAU/MAU、日期、估计方法；不以累计注册/下载替代 |
| L2-COMMERCE | 所有权、供需组织或交易规则的结构变化已执行，并影响规定数量的外部主体 | 交易两方外的已发生变化；融资/估值/产能规划本身不够 |
| L2-GOVERNANCE | 有约束力或先例效力的行为，适用超出具名当事人，有独立法律分析 | 适用范围/效力；一般提案、立案或索取资料不够 |
| L2-SAFETY | 有记录事故、外部实际补救行动、独立调查 | 调查发现；只有当事方自述报告不够 |
| L2-SAFETY-PRACTICE | 新安全实践，规定数量的无关联组织实际在生产采用 | 执行情况；承诺/评估框架发布不够 |
| L2-SOCIETY | 测得行为变化、规定数量独立人群及持续观察时长 | 行为与人群，不是搜索热度或短期话题 |

“新工作流”须描述旧流程→新流程，任务完成方式或参与者责任确实变化；“结构变化”须描述旧结构→新结构，而非只有规模增加。阈值的精确数字只维护在 policy.json。它们是**编辑政策，不是自然定律或预测实现标准**。

**SIG-03 / MUST**：L2 至少满足一个路径；L3 至少满足 policy 指定的不同类别数、观察期及独立起源数，并解释相互关联的跨领域持续变化。时间跨度长不等于持续观察；不能用“事件发生至今很多年”填观察期。否则最高可支持 L2。L3 不是 impactIndex 达到某个分数的别名。

**SIG-04 / MUST**：评审记录包括“已改变什么”“为何不是更低/更高”“至少两个已发布对照事件”。对照仅比较事实阶段、证据和变化类型，不照抄历史等级。旧证据包不足时输出“无法重评/待补证”，不能直接宣判降级。分歧不取平均：先比较证据截止日和未知项，再复核路径；解决不了则保留旧公开级别并阻止本轮评级变更。

## 5. 影响分、共识和争议

**IMP-01 / MUST**：影响只计已观察到的后果。尚未发生的潜在影响可以作为明确标注的 interpretation/open question，不进入影响指数。L1 尚无可核实影响时允许 impacts=[]、impactIndex=0；不为凑齐结构捏造影响。L2/L3 仍需影响条目和 impact claim。

**IMP-02 / MUST**：严重度按绝对值逐级检验：0=实测无方向性变化；1=有方向但未达到实质变化；2=证据支持工作流/权利/成本/风险暴露/行为等具体基线发生实质改变；3=满足 2 且达到政策规定受众广度与持续观察期。正负分别记录；风险的“存在”与损害的“发生”不能互换。记录 baseline/outcome/materialChange，严禁用情绪形容词代替。

**IMP-03 / MUST**：受众只用 policy 中互斥程度尽可能高的角色 ID；同一主体承担不同已证实角色才可重复跨组计入。developers 不得改写成 programmers/coders 分别加分。每个 impact 独立记录观察起止日；timeframe 由天数阈值计算，不由预测持续时间决定。0–29/30–179/180–364/365+ 天对应当前四档，精确值以配置为准。短期观察不得借长期预期拿耐久加分。

**IMP-04 / MUST**：保留 v2.3 公式及四舍五入方式，见 DATA-MODEL；不静默改写历史分数。它是影响量级摘要，不是概率、质量或有益程度；负向严重后果同样增加绝对影响。现公式理论最高舍入为 9（各项上限总和 9），0–10 是字段取值边界而非保证覆盖的量表；不得人工凑 10。

**CONS-01 / MUST**：emerging=主要影响证据仍积累；debated=存在有证据的规模/归因/解释分歧；broad=主要影响有至少两组独立支持且无未解决的实质反证。仅事实发布获得多家报道不能叫 broad。controversy 标记具体争议的存在，不是 emerging 的同义词；所有等级的 controversy=true 均需 limitation claim 和相应证据。

## 6. Arc、方向与语言

**ARC-01 / MUST**：Arc 只引用已发布事件，按 ARC-MODEL 的章节/时间跨度要求。章节论点是可辩论的编辑解释，不能新增未经核实事实；每个新增重要判断在 review 中留证据和反例。引用事件或来源变化时复核受影响章节；不得为了“有立场”编造因果。

**DIR-01 / MUST**：方向仍按 POSSIBLE-DIRECTIONS-SCREENING：至少两个公开事件、两个有事实锚点的 observed signals、独立来源与反向约束。run 中方向决定和 editorial.screeningRunId 必须连通。默认 monitor_only；外部共识证据不足时不能用事件评级的内部数值门槛宣布方向实现。

**LANG-01 / MUST**：中英文共享同一事实/主张台账，主体、数字、单位、日期、条件、否定、不确定性强度必须一致；任何语言都不享有“事实优先权”。可以从原始材料先写任一语言，也可以并行写作；不得为了自然表达增加事实。事件 summary 事实先行，Arc 可论点先行但必须有证据，方向区分当前基线与尚未成为常态的可能变化。

**LANG-02 / SHOULD**：句式、长度、修辞建议不是事实门禁。不得把某个“把/让/了”字或首句句法视为自动退稿理由；应检查主语、因果和证据是否清楚。语言人工复核与机械结构检查分开报告。

## 7. 完成标准与覆盖边界

- 规则完成：权威入口、阶段合同、含未知的评级分支、冲突处理、证据/审批/历史例外都有明确路径。
- 实现完成：正反例涵盖常规可发布、信息不足、证据来源混同、过期批准、错误引用、历史豁免绕过、影响重复计分及方向/Arc 边界。
- 校准完成：冻结案例与反事实样本，标注哪些是原有数据、哪些是测试构造；记录规则改动理由。**不等于旧事件已事实重审。**
- 跨模型验收：独立会话使用同一冻结证据、同一政策、同一提示词；对照 [CALIBRATION](CALIBRATION.md) 计算一致率、覆盖率和硬规则违规。未实测不得说已达标。

机械校验能查：字段/枚举/阈值/引用/日期/文件与摘要/证据上限/批准绑定。
机械校验不能查：摘录语义是否真的证明结论、组织是否真正无关联、是否完整发现候选、语言是否自然、人工批准是否真实、因果归因是否充分。上述 MUST 仍是评审职责，不因自动通过而免除。


===== ARC MODEL =====
# EpochArc 专题叙事标准 v2.4

规则边界：[EDITORIAL-STANDARD](../workflow/EDITORIAL-STANDARD.md) ARC-01、LANG-01/02。结构继承现有构建器，新增审核使用 [REVIEW-CONTRACT](../data/REVIEW-CONTRACT.md)。

## 1. 定位

Arc 将已发布事件组织成可阅读、可辩论的解释线索，不是新闻堆叠，也不是为了“锋利”而制造立场。

合格选题须有：

- 明确问题或可检验论点。
- 足够的已发布事件支持。
- 能指出反例、限制或替代解释。
- 判断力度不超过证据。

允许编辑解释，但应区分事实、归因与推测。中立不等于不作判断；有立场也不等于可以忽略反证。

## 2. 常见结构（SHOULD，不限制新结构）

| 结构 | 目标 |
|---|---|
| 技术演进 | 解释方法、约束与选择如何演化 |
| 主题线索 | 围绕安全、治理、开放性等跨事件问题 |
| 社会变化 | 从受影响人群的可观察行为组织事件 |
| 竞争路线 | 比较不同方案的证据、收益和限制，不预设赢家 |

不要求每章刻意反直觉，也不要求把仍有争议的问题写成确定答案。

## 3. MUST：数据结构

唯一编辑源 `content/arcs/*.json`；`data/arcs.json`、`arcs/{id}/index.html` 是构建输出。

每条含 id/title/subtitle/abstract/chapters/conclusion/status/editorial；文本为完整 en/zhHans。

- 3–6 章，每章 id/title/narrative/anchorEvents/keyInsight。
- 每章 2–5 个不重复的已发布锚点事件。
- 全文至少 5 个不同锚点事件。
- 最晚与最早事件年份差至少 3，沿用当前机械口径；不是用单月合集冒充长期演变。
- relatedArcs 不能自引、重复或引用未发布专题。
- 日期范围、分类和覆盖数量从锚点派生，不维护第二套数字。

## 4. MUST：论证与证据

- 每章有明确的论点或问题；可以论点先行，不受事件 summary 首句事实模板约束。
- 用锚点中的事实支持解释，不把锚点链接当成对所有新判断的兜底引用。
- 新增重要事实先按事件事实标准核实；新增重要解释在 review.evidence 中记录摘录、来源、章节/论点标识。
- 至少处理一个实质反例或替代解释，review.counterEvidence 记录检索结果；找不到时说明已查范围，不能虚构反方。
- 结语可以给出有限结论或尚未解决的问题，不强制预测市场赢家。
- 同一事件在不同 Arc 可以有不同解释，但不能出现相互冲突的未经说明的事实版本。

## 5. 双语与文风

中英文共享事实/主张台账。允许先写任一语言或并行写作；不得强制“中文不能看英文”，也不得强制“英文永远为准”。最终核对主体、数字、时点、因果、限制和不确定性，不要求逐句镜像。

建议英文 abstract 40–60 词、章节 narrative 100–200 词、conclusion 60–100 词；中文按自然信息量调整。这些是 SHOULD，不是牺牲事实边界的硬字数。

避免空洞自我介绍和营销语言。可用主动或被动句，以责任主体明确为先；不得为避免被动语态将“validated”自动改成更强的“proved”。

## 6. 复核与发布

1. 检查全部锚点为 published，章节结构与派生元数据正确。
2. review.eventIds 覆盖所有锚点；inputsDigest 绑定锚点及其公开来源，防止引用内容已变而复核仍称有效。
3. review 记录 changeReason/counterEvidence、证据、双语核对、操作者及实际日期。
4. 精确版本人工批准，运行统一校验、测试、构建。
5. 本地检查 TOC、事件链接、canonical/hreflang、两种语言及样式；生成页面不手改。
6. 无明确授权不 push。事件或来源改变时，重新检查受影响章节并更新对应 review/approval。

程序可检查引用与结构，不能证明论点有说服力或因果成立；这部分由证据复核负责。


===== REVIEW CONTRACT =====
# v2.4 编辑证据与审批契约

规则语义见 [EDITORIAL-STANDARD](../workflow/EDITORIAL-STANDARD.md)。公开数据结构沿用 DATA-MODEL；新增审计材料放在 `governance/`，不复制到公开 data 目录。不为旧数据补造审核。

## 文件组织

| 路径 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| governance/policy.json | 版本化参数，不是公开方向的实现标准 |
| governance/legacy-baseline.json | 一次性历史内容指纹；禁止重新生成以绕过门禁 |
| governance/runs/*.json | 新批次，包含发现/筛选及方向决定 |
| governance/evidence/* | 实际采集的文本/响应摘录，可分子目录 |
| governance/reviews/*.json | 针对精确编辑版本的复核记录 |
| governance/approvals/*.json | 真实人工批准的引用，不由构建生成 |
| governance/calibration/ | 非发布用冻结案例与测试变体 |
| governance/audits/ | 历史债务和结构审计，不是事实审核证书 |

JSON 对象摘要：UTF-8、ensure_ascii=False、sort_keys=True、separators=(',', ':') 后 SHA-256。文件摘要是原始字节 SHA-256。使用 `scripts/editorial_policy.digest`，不得拿 Git blob SHA 替代。

## Run

必填：`policyVersion`（字符串 2.4）、`runId`、`kind`（full/targeted/backfill）、`windowStart`、`windowEnd`、`evidenceCutoff`（均 YYYY-MM-DD）、`timezone`（UTC）、`baselineCommit`（40 位 SHA）、`operator`、`model`、`promptVersion`、`channels`、`categoryCoverage`、`candidates`。

- 非 full 要 `scopeReason`；full 要全部核心通道和六类覆盖。
- channel：`id/status/coverageNote/attempts`；非 complete 要 reason；partial/unavailable 要 retryResult；complete 要 windowCovered=true，且实际覆盖须由评审检查。
- attempt：`query/executedAt/artifact/sha256/resultCount`。时间为带时区 ISO 时间戳；文件限 governance/evidence 下。
- categoryCoverage：每项 `category/status/finding`。
- candidate：`candidateId/discoveryUrls/scores/scoreReasons/total/priority/decision/reason`。五个评分字段和五个理由字段必须完全匹配 policy。
- priority=skip/pool/confirm；decision=skip/hold/new/update/merge。最后三个要求 eventId 和 confirmation；优先级不足时补 priorityOverrideReason。
- confirmation：恰好 fact/impact/analysis/controversy，各含 `status/query/finding/evidenceIds`。found 不得为空；not_found/blocked 可空。
- directionDecisions（方向更新时）：每项 `id/decision/reason`，公开对象必须恰有一个 publish 决定。

## Source / 公开 editorial

新建或修改 Source 增加 `publisherId/originId/accessedAt`。originId 是主要信息起源，不能把转载 URL 自身当作独立起源。

v2.4 已审核/发布对象的 editorial 必填：

- `createdAt/updatedAt/reviewedAt/lastSourceCheckAt`（实际行为日期）。
- `curator/reviewer`（真实操作者，可是明确的 AI 会话标识，不等于人类批准）。
- `reviewProvenance: v2.4`、`reviewRecord`（governance/reviews 下的相对路径）。
- `changeLog` 非空：date/changeType/summary。
- 公开内容 `publishedAt` 保持首次记录日期。方向还需 `screeningRunId`。

新建 candidate/draft 只需基础数据结构，不要求编造复核/批准；reviewed 开始强制本契约。已有公开记录改变或归档不能退回 draft 来逃避审核。

## Review 公共字段

`policyVersion/policyDigest/kind/subjectId/subjectDigest/inputsDigest/evidenceCutoff/preparedBy/model/reviewedBy/reviewMethod/limitations/languageReview/evidence`。

policyDigest 绑定当前 policy 全对象；policy.rulesDigest 绑定规则总表的原始文件字节。因此规则正文改变也会使审核与批准失效，不能只沿用版本号。

- kind=event/arc/direction。
- inputsDigest=`review_inputs(kind, record, sources, events)`：绑定公开来源及 Arc/方向的锚点事件；依赖变更后旧复核失效。
- reviewMethod=independent_model/human/self_review。L2/L3 不允许仅 self_review。
- independent_model 还需不同的 producerSessionId/reviewerSessionId 和 reviewerModel。不同 actor 字符串不等于已真正独立，必须保存实际会话凭据供人工追溯。
- limitations 为非空字符串数组，哪怕只是明确“离线校验不能确认语义”。
- languageReview：factsAligned=true、notes，表示完成了实际的双语事实核对，不是机器自动测得。

### evidence 每项

`id/sourceId/claimId/url/originId/accessedAt/relationship/verification/quote/locator/artifact/sha256`。

- quote 是逐字文本，必须出现在留存文本中；截图/PDF 先形成可定位的文本摘录，并保存页码/章节定位。
- relationship=primary/independent/interested/unknown；verification=direct/independent_verification/reported/context。
- 每个事件 claim 都有证据，摘录 sourceIds 必须与 claim.sourceIds 相等；所有评审来源都应在公开 sources 引用中。
- 同一来源对不同 claim 的独立关系、验证对象可能不同，要分别记录。
- 访问和来源发布日期不晚于 evidenceCutoff。不能事后看了新材料却声称使用旧截止日。
- Arc 的 claimId 为稳定的章节/论点标识；来源可来自自身 sources 或锚点公开事件。方向的 signal 使用对应 signal.id 为 claimId，并匹配 sourceIds；基线/限制另设稳定标识。机器不验证这些文本的语义。

## Event 专属字段

- `runId/candidateId/runDigest`：匹配一个 selected candidate；截止日一致。
- `coreFactClaimIds`：明确节点身份所依赖的核心事实 claim；非空，均为 fact 且证据等级至少 B，不能用一个无关事实掩盖主事实不足。
- identity：`seriesId/action/stage/dateBasis/deduplicationReason/comparedEventIds/decision`。decision 与候选一致。
- classification：`primary/reason`；有次分类时 `secondaryClaimId` 指向确实不同的主张。
- significance：`rationale/whyNotHigher/whyNotLower/comparisonEventIds/routes`；至少两个其他已发布对照事件。
- route：`ruleId/criteria`。criteria 键集合与 policy 完全相同。
- criterion finding：`value/rationale/evidenceIds`。未知 value=null，可无证据；已知值需证据。布尔/计数不能混用。
- 组织/群体/后续工作计数：`entityIds` 数量必须等于 value；ID 指无关联控制主体/研究团队，而非同机构不同项目。人工验证独立性。
- observed_days：`observedSince/observedUntil`，由日期差复算。
- verified_active_users：`metric` 为 DAU/WAU/MAU、`measuredAt`；引用材料还须解释测量或估算方法。
- L3 significance 增加 `observedSince/observedUntil`，实证持续期达到配置，独立验证数量达标。
- L2 无一手资料时 `primaryUnavailableReason`；不能免除核心事实 B 级和路径验证。
- impactBasis 与 impacts **逐项同序**，各含 `dimension/observation/evidenceIds/observedSince/observedUntil/baseline/outcome/materialChange`；observation 只允许 observed。没有观察影响的 L1 两数组均空、impactIndex=0。
- consensus：`level/reason/evidenceIds`；broad 至少两组独立支持主要影响。
- dispute：`exists/reason/evidenceIds`；争议为真时有证据及 limitation claim。

## Arc / Direction 专属字段

两者都需要 `changeReason/counterEvidence/eventIds`；eventIds 恰好覆盖全部公开锚点。

方向另有 `screeningDecision: publish/consensusSearch/independentSourceIds/runId/runDigest`，关联 run.directionDecisions 及 editorial.screeningRunId。独立来源要有摘录支持且起源和控制主体均达到门槛。其余信号/共识/生命周期约束沿用正式 schema。

## Approval

路径：`governance/approvals/{subjectDigest}.json`。

必填：`subjectId/subjectDigest/reviewDigest/policyDigest/decision/actorType/actor/approvedAt/confirmationRef`。

- decision=approve，actorType=human；日期不早于 reviewedAt。
- reviewDigest 绑定 review 全对象，policyDigest 绑定 policy 全对象。审核内容或规则改变，旧批准不再生效。
- confirmationRef 指向实际确认消息或工单；程序不认证其真实性，项目负责人必须核对。
- 文件内不能写秘钥、会话 token 或不必要的个人信息。
- 归档已发布事件同样需要批准。旧基线未变的记录不要求追造历史批准。

## 可执行样例

完整合格与不合格样例由 `tests/test_editorial_policy.py` 在临时目录创建，均为明确的合成测试材料，不作为真实审核或批准入库。运行 `npm run test:editorial` 检查契约。禁止把测试证据/测试人工身份复制成生产审核。

Yeah, it was that bad. The account is visible as we write this, but the offending tweets are gone; Tay has [gone to "sleep"](https://twitter.com/TayandYou/status/712856578567839745) for now.

It's not certain how Microsoft will teach Tay better manners, although it seems like word filters would be a good start. Frankly, though, this kind of incident isn't a shock — if we've learned anything in recent years, it's that leaving something completely open to input from the internet is guaranteed to [invite abuse](http://www.nytimes.com/2016/03/22/world/europe/boaty-mcboatface-what-you-get-when-you-let-the-internet-decide.html?_r=0).

Two and a half years later, our honest assessment is that some parts of this theory of change have played out as we hoped, but others have not. The following are the areas in which the RSP has been successful:

*   Our RSP **did**incentivize us to develop stronger safeguards. For example, in order to comply with our ASL-3 deployment standard (which is primarily about risks from chemical and biological weapons from threat actors with relatively modest resources and expertise), we developed increasingly sophisticated and accurate methods (specifically, [input and output classifiers](https://www.anthropic.com/research/constitutional-classifiers)) to block content of concern.
*   More broadly, the overall implementation of the ASL-3 standard **did** prove feasible. We [activated ASL-3 safeguards](https://www.anthropic.com/news/activating-asl3-protections) for relevant models in May 2025 and have been working to improve them ever since.

Some companies have also [implemented](https://cdn.openai.com/gpt-5-system-card.pdf) bioweapon-related classifiers in a similar vein to our ASL-3 defenses. # Media  Statement 

X FAILS TO IMPLEMENT SA FEGUARDS, MCMC ORDERS TEMPORARY 

RESTRICTIONS ON GROK 

CYBERJAYA, 11 January 2026  – The Malaysian Communications and Multimedia 

Commission (MCMC) has directed a temporary restriction on access to the Grok 

artificial intelligence for users in Malaysia, effective 11 January 2026. 

This action follows repeated misuse of Grok to generate obscene, sexually 

explicit, indecent, grossly offensive, and non -consensual manipulated images, 

including content involving women and minors, despite prior regulatory 

engagement and formal notices iss ued to X Corp. and xAI LLC. 

MCMC had issued notices to X Corp. and xAI LLC on 3 January 2026 and 8 January 

2026 to demand, amongst others, the implementation of effective technical and 

moderation safeguards to prevent AI -generated content that may contravene 

Malaysian law, including  Section 233 of the Communications and Multimedia Act 

1998. 

However, the responses submitted on 7 January 2026 and 9 January 2026 by X 

Corp. relied primarily on user -initiated reporting mechanisms and failed to 

address the inherent risks posed by the design and operation of the AI tool. 

MCMC considers this insufficient to prevent harm or ensure legal compliance. 

Accordingly, the restriction is imposed as a preventive and proportionate 

measure while legal and regulatory processes are ongoing. Access to Grok will 

remain restricted until effective safeguards are implemented, particularly to 

prevent content involving  women and children. MCMC remains open to 

engagement with X Corp. and xAI LLC subject to demonstrable compliance with 

Malaysian law. 2

Members of the public are strongly urged to promptly report harmful online 

content to MCMC and, where appropriate, lodge police reports with the Royal 

Malaysia Police. 

MCMC  CORPORATE COMMUNICATIONS

## Potential Misuse and Security Risks

The heavy sharing on GitHub (thousands of forks, stars, and mirrors by developers worldwide) turns this into a vector for abuse. Key risks include:

1.   **Supply chain attacks via malicious forks and mirrors:** Thousands of repositories now host the leaked code or derivatives. Threat actors can (and already are) seeding trojanized versions with backdoors, data exfiltrators, or cryptominers. Unsuspecting users cloning “official-looking” forks risks immediate compromise.
2.   **Amplified exploitation of known vulnerabilities and discovery of new vulnerabilities:** Pre-existing flaws (e.g., CVE-2025-59536, CVE-2026-21852, RCE and API key exfiltration via malicious repo configs, hooks, MCP servers, and env vars) are now far easier to weaponize. Threat actors with full source visibility can craft precise malicious repositories or project files that trigger arbitrary shell execution or credential theft simply by cloning/opening an untrusted repo. The exposed hook and permission logic makes silent device takeover more reliable.
3.   **Local environment and developer workstation compromise:** Users building or running the leaked code locally introduce unvetted dependencies and execution paths. The leak coincided exactly with a [separate malicious Axios](https://www.zscaler.com/blogs/security-research/supply-chain-attacks-surge-march-2026)`npm` supply chain attack (RATs published March 31, 00:21–03:29 UTC), creating a perfect storm for anyone updating Claude Code via npm that day.

## ThreatLabz discovers “Claude Code leak” lure that distributes Vidar and GhostSocks

While monitoring GitHub for threats, ThreatLabz came across a “Claude Code leak” repository published by idbzoomh (links located in the IOC section). The repository looks like it’s trying to pass itself off as leaked TypeScript source code for Anthropic’s Claude Code CLI. The README file even claims the code was exposed through a `.map` file in the npm package and then rebuilt into a working fork with “unlocked” enterprise features and no message limits.

The repository link appears near the top of Google results for searches like “leaked Claude Code,” which makes it easy for curious users to encounter, as shown in the figure below.

Title: Attorney General James Uthmeier Files First-in-the-Nation State-Led Lawsuit Against OpenAI, CEO Sam Altman for Deceptive Practices and Harms to Floridians

URL Source: https://www.myfloridalegal.com/newsrelease/attorney-general-james-uthmeier-files-first-nation-state-led-lawsuit-against-openai-ceo

Published Time: Sat, 17 Oct 2026 00:39:48 GMT

Markdown Content:
Release Date

Jun 1, 2026

Phone

(850) 245-0150

![Image 1](https://www.myfloridalegal.com/sites/default/files/2026-03/dsc06064.jpg)

_Courtesy of the Office of the Attorney General_

**TALLAHASSEE, Fla**.—Attorney General James Uthmeier announced legal action against OpenAI and its Chief Executive Officer, Sam Altman, alleging that the company knowingly released and aggressively marketed ChatGPT to the public—including to children—while concealing serious risks, suppressing internal safety warnings, and deceiving Floridians about the true nature and dangers of the product.

“Today, we announced the first-in-the-nation state-led lawsuit against OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman,” **said Attorney General James Uthmeier.** “OpenAI and Altman ignored internal and external safety warnings, put children at great risk, and allowed a dangerous product to reach millions of Floridians.”

“Today’s AI companies have largely assisted with the evolution of the digital playground. Protecting our children means teaching them to navigate not just the real people behind the screens, but the artificial minds engineered to mimic them,” **said FDLE Special Agent in Charge Mike Duffey.** “Parental vigilance must shift from simply monitoring who our children talk to, to ensuring they understand what they are talking to—because a machine programmed to please can never replace the safety of human boundaries.”

The civil complaint alleges that OpenAI and Altman prioritized speed to market and commercial gain over user safety, disregarded repeated warnings from experts both inside and outside the company, and deployed a product that facilitates and encourages harm—including self-harm and violence—while falsely assuring users it was safe.

The complaint also alleges that ChatGPT collects data from minors without meaningful parental oversight, causes behavioral addiction and cognitive harm, and is prone to dangerous errors that the company has actively downplayed.

Florida law prohibits unfair and defective trade practices. The complaint alleges that OpenAI’s conduct causes ongoing harm to Floridians and demands accountability. The State seeks damages on behalf of the people of Florida and an end to the deceptive and dangerous practices outlined in the complaint.

Last month, the Office of Statewide Prosecution [launched a criminal investigation](https://www.myfloridalegal.com/newsrelease/attorney-general-james-uthmeier-launches-criminal-investigation-openai-chatgpt) after prosecutors reviewed chat logs between ChatGPT and Phoenix Ikner, the gunman who opened fire at Florida State University on April 17, 2025, claiming two lives and injuring several others. The criminal investigation is ongoing.

To read the full complaint as filed in the Tenth Judicial Circuit of Florida, click [here](https://www.myfloridalegal.com/sites/default/files/openai-filed-stamped-complaint.pdf).

# Just the Docs: Eight States Sue OpenAI, Alleging It Misled the Public About ChatGPT’s Safety

By [Matthew Nagle](https://www.justsecurity.org/author/naglematthew/ "Profile and articles by Matthew Nagle")

Published on October 15, 2026

The attorneys general of[Arizona](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Arizona.pdf),[Arkansas](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Arkansas.pdf),[Idaho](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Idaho.pdf),[Iowa](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Iowa.pdf),[Kansas](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Kansas.pdf),[Montana](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Montana.pdf),[Nebraska](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Nebraska.pdf), and[West Virginia](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/West-Virginia.pdf) filed coordinated lawsuits against OpenAI in their own state courts on Oct. 14. The suits bring claims under state consumer protection laws, alleging that OpenAI marketed ChatGPT as safe while concealing its risks. They also present those risks as a threat to public safety.

- 发布、预览、可用、部署、立法通过、生效、裁判、事故、披露、完成等阶段发生实质变化，且有独立日期与事实：可 new；必须说明与旧节点的区别，不能每次报道都新建。
- 同一系列但不同阶段不自动 new：没有新增权利/可用性/法律状态/已发生后果的仅 update。
- 两个节点重复描述同一动作：提出 merge 方案；合并涉及旧 URL 时先做迁移审核，不直接删除。
- 调查/起诉是程序事实，不等于认定违法；计划/签约不等于完成；可用不等于采用；开源公告不等于已开放权重。

**IDENT-02 / MUST**：日期取节点所述动作真实发生日；只知披露日就将节点定义为披露。保留 day/month/year 的证据精度，不制造 1 日。不再凭“普通人感知到的时刻”挑热度峰值。`evidenceCutoff` 是本轮可用证据截止日，允许后来的真实影响支持历史事件的回顾评级，不能伪称当年已经可知。

**CLASS-01 / MUST**：主分类按节点的核心动作，而不是评级或品牌：方法/能力→capability；产品可用性/使用方式→product；资本/所有权/市场结构→commerce；立法/监管/裁判→governance；事故/风险治理实践→safety；有证据的社会行为→society。法院动作即使源于事故仍主归 governance；事故节点主归 safety；融资不因为投向芯片变成 capability。

**CLASS-02 / MUST**：最多一个次分类，必须绑定一个不同于主分类核心事实的、独立成句且有来源的 claim。删去这个 claim 会丢失一个实际变化，才保留次分类。废止不可测的“30% 信息丢失”标准。多个合理主分类仍并列时：按节点标题动作选择；不能确定则在评审中解决，不能用数组顺序随机表达。

**EVID-01 / MUST**：每个 claim 都绑定逐字摘录、定位信息、URL、实际访问日期、文本留存文件哈希和 claim-local originId。哈希证明本地文件未变，不证明网页真实性。保留必要上下文；不把搜索摘要作为已读全文。付费/失效/无权限记 blocked，优先找原始材料或可靠存档，不能填造摘录。

**EVID-02 / MUST**：Tier 评价来源性质；A–D 评价这条主张的证明力度。publisherId 对同控制主体去重；originId 对同原始信息起源去重。转载同一公司新闻稿、两个媒体复述同一厂商跑分，不是两次验证。来源默认 originId 可记录整篇主要起源，摘录级 originId 用于混合来源稿件。关系分 primary/independent/interested/unknown，验证分 direct/independent_verification/reported/context。

- A：原始直接材料＋不同起源/控制主体的独立验证；或至少两组独立验证。仅“报道了有该公告”不验证性能。
- B：可靠 Tier 1 直接支持；或两个不同起源、不同控制主体的独立 Tier 2。
- C：可靠单一独立二手支持；不能升级为已经独立复现。
- D：只有传闻、未核实营销、百科背景或未知链条。不能支撑公开事实/影响。

百科可用于背景，不独立满足发布证据门槛。厂商公告可以直接证明“厂商宣称 X”，不能直接证明“X 性能优于 Y”。每条核心事实至少 B。L2 还必须满足对应变化路径；缺一手材料时须说明原因，核心事实仍需两个独立 Tier 2。L3 必须有原始材料及规定数量的独立起源，核心转折不得依赖 C。

**SIG-01 / MUST**：先确认事实，再评历史意义；不以融资额、厂商声量、新闻数量、模型参数或初筛总分直接指定 L2。L1 不代表“不重要”，只表示目前未证明符合更高等级。没有等级比例配额。

| ruleId | 已发生的变化（所有条件 AND；不同路径 OR） | 独立验证对象 |

**SIG-03 / MUST**：L2 至少满足一个路径；L3 至少满足 policy 指定的不同类别数、观察期及独立起源数，并解释相互关联的跨领域持续变化。时间跨度长不等于持续观察；不能用“事件发生至今很多年”填观察期。否则最高可支持 L2。L3 不是 impactIndex 达到某个分数的别名。

**IMP-02 / MUST**：严重度按绝对值逐级检验：0=实测无方向性变化；1=有方向但未达到实质变化；2=证据支持工作流/权利/成本/风险暴露/行为等具体基线发生实质改变；3=满足 2 且达到政策规定受众广度与持续观察期。正负分别记录；风险的“存在”与损害的“发生”不能互换。记录 baseline/outcome/materialChange，严禁用情绪形容词代替。

**IMP-03 / MUST**：受众只用 policy 中互斥程度尽可能高的角色 ID；同一主体承担不同已证实角色才可重复跨组计入。developers 不得改写成 programmers/coders 分别加分。每个 impact 独立记录观察起止日；timeframe 由天数阈值计算，不由预测持续时间决定。0–29/30–179/180–364/365+ 天对应当前四档，精确值以配置为准。短期观察不得借长期预期拿耐久加分。

**IMP-04 / MUST**：保留 v2.3 公式及四舍五入方式，见 DATA-MODEL；不静默改写历史分数。它是影响量级摘要，不是概率、质量或有益程度；负向严重后果同样增加绝对影响。现公式理论最高舍入为 9（各项上限总和 9），0–10 是字段取值边界而非保证覆盖的量表；不得人工凑 10。

**CONS-01 / MUST**：emerging=主要影响证据仍积累；debated=存在有证据的规模/归因/解释分歧；broad=主要影响有至少两组独立支持且无未解决的实质反证。仅事实发布获得多家报道不能叫 broad。controversy 标记具体争议的存在，不是 emerging 的同义词；所有等级的 controversy=true 均需 limitation claim 和相应证据。

## 6. Arc、方向与语言

**ARC-01 / MUST**：Arc 只引用已发布事件，按 ARC-MODEL 的章节/时间跨度要求。章节论点是可辩论的编辑解释，不能新增未经核实事实；每个新增重要判断在 review 中留证据和反例。引用事件或来源变化时复核受影响章节；不得为了“有立场”编造因果。

**DIR-01 / MUST**：方向仍按 POSSIBLE-DIRECTIONS-SCREENING：至少两个公开事件、两个有事实锚点的 observed signals、独立来源与反向约束。run 中方向决定和 editorial.screeningRunId 必须连通。默认 monitor_only；外部共识证据不足时不能用事件评级的内部数值门槛宣布方向实现。

**LANG-01 / MUST**：中英文共享同一事实/主张台账，主体、数字、单位、日期、条件、否定、不确定性强度必须一致；任何语言都不享有“事实优先权”。可以从原始材料先写任一语言，也可以并行写作；不得为了自然表达增加事实。事件 summary 事实先行，Arc 可论点先行但必须有证据，方向区分当前基线与尚未成为常态的可能变化。

**LANG-02 / SHOULD**：句式、长度、修辞建议不是事实门禁。不得把某个“把/让/了”字或首句句法视为自动退稿理由；应检查主语、因果和证据是否清楚。语言人工复核与机械结构检查分开报告。

## 7. 完成标准与覆盖边界

- 规则完成：权威入口、阶段合同、含未知的评级分支、冲突处理、证据/审批/历史例外都有明确路径。
- 实现完成：正反例涵盖常规可发布、信息不足、证据来源混同、过期批准、错误引用、历史豁免绕过、影响重复计分及方向/Arc 边界。
- 校准完成：冻结案例与反事实样本，标注哪些是原有数据、哪些是测试构造；记录规则改动理由。**不等于旧事件已事实重审。**
- 跨模型验收：独立会话使用同一冻结证据、同一政策、同一提示词；对照 [CALIBRATION](CALIBRATION.md) 计算一致率、覆盖率和硬规则违规。未实测不得说已达标。

机械校验能查：字段/枚举/阈值/引用/日期/文件与摘要/证据上限/批准绑定。
机械校验不能查：摘录语义是否真的证明结论、组织是否真正无关联、是否完整发现候选、语言是否自然、人工批准是否真实、因果归因是否充分。上述 MUST 仍是评审职责，不因自动通过而免除。


===== ARC MODEL =====
# EpochArc 专题叙事标准 v2.4

规则边界：[EDITORIAL-STANDARD](../workflow/EDITORIAL-STANDARD.md) ARC-01、LANG-01/02。结构继承现有构建器，新增审核使用 [REVIEW-CONTRACT](../data/REVIEW-CONTRACT.md)。

## 1. 定位

Arc 将已发布事件组织成可阅读、可辩论的解释线索，不是新闻堆叠，也不是为了“锋利”而制造立场。

合格选题须有：

- 明确问题或可检验论点。
- 足够的已发布事件支持。
- 能指出反例、限制或替代解释。
- 判断力度不超过证据。

允许编辑解释，但应区分事实、归因与推测。中立不等于不作判断；有立场也不等于可以忽略反证。

## 2. 常见结构（SHOULD，不限制新结构）

| 结构 | 目标 |
|---|---|
| 技术演进 | 解释方法、约束与选择如何演化 |
| 主题线索 | 围绕安全、治理、开放性等跨事件问题 |
| 社会变化 | 从受影响人群的可观察行为组织事件 |
| 竞争路线 | 比较不同方案的证据、收益和限制，不预设赢家 |

不要求每章刻意反直觉，也不要求把仍有争议的问题写成确定答案。

## 3. MUST：数据结构

唯一编辑源 `content/arcs/*.json`；`data/arcs.json`、`arcs/{id}/index.html` 是构建输出。

每条含 id/title/subtitle/abstract/chapters/conclusion/status/editorial；文本为完整 en/zhHans。

- 3–6 章，每章 id/title/narrative/anchorEvents/keyInsight。
- 每章 2–5 个不重复的已发布锚点事件。
- 全文至少 5 个不同锚点事件。
- 最晚与最早事件年份差至少 3，沿用当前机械口径；不是用单月合集冒充长期演变。
- relatedArcs 不能自引、重复或引用未发布专题。
- 日期范围、分类和覆盖数量从锚点派生，不维护第二套数字。

## 4. MUST：论证与证据

- 每章有明确的论点或问题；可以论点先行，不受事件 summary 首句事实模板约束。
- 用锚点中的事实支持解释，不把锚点链接当成对所有新判断的兜底引用。
- 新增重要事实先按事件事实标准核实；新增重要解释在 review.evidence 中记录摘录、来源、章节/论点标识。
- 至少处理一个实质反例或替代解释，review.counterEvidence 记录检索结果；找不到时说明已查范围，不能虚构反方。
- 结语可以给出有限结论或尚未解决的问题，不强制预测市场赢家。
- 同一事件在不同 Arc 可以有不同解释，但不能出现相互冲突的未经说明的事实版本。

## 5. 双语与文风

中英文共享事实/主张台账。允许先写任一语言或并行写作；不得强制“中文不能看英文”，也不得强制“英文永远为准”。最终核对主体、数字、时点、因果、限制和不确定性，不要求逐句镜像。

建议英文 abstract 40–60 词、章节 narrative 100–200 词、conclusion 60–100 词；中文按自然信息量调整。这些是 SHOULD，不是牺牲事实边界的硬字数。

避免空洞自我介绍和营销语言。可用主动或被动句，以责任主体明确为先；不得为避免被动语态将“validated”自动改成更强的“proved”。

## 6. 复核与发布

1. 检查全部锚点为 published，章节结构与派生元数据正确。
2. review.eventIds 覆盖所有锚点；inputsDigest 绑定锚点及其公开来源，防止引用内容已变而复核仍称有效。
3. review 记录 changeReason/counterEvidence、证据、双语核对、操作者及实际日期。
4. 精确版本人工批准，运行统一校验、测试、构建。
5. 本地检查 TOC、事件链接、canonical/hreflang、两种语言及样式；生成页面不手改。
6. 无明确授权不 push。事件或来源改变时，重新检查受影响章节并更新对应 review/approval。

程序可检查引用与结构，不能证明论点有说服力或因果成立；这部分由证据复核负责。


===== REVIEW CONTRACT =====
# v2.4 编辑证据与审批契约

规则语义见 [EDITORIAL-STANDARD](../workflow/EDITORIAL-STANDARD.md)。公开数据结构沿用 DATA-MODEL；新增审计材料放在 `governance/`，不复制到公开 data 目录。不为旧数据补造审核。

## 文件组织

| 路径 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| governance/policy.json | 版本化参数，不是公开方向的实现标准 |
| governance/legacy-baseline.json | 一次性历史内容指纹；禁止重新生成以绕过门禁 |
| governance/runs/*.json | 新批次，包含发现/筛选及方向决定 |
| governance/evidence/* | 实际采集的文本/响应摘录，可分子目录 |
| governance/reviews/*.json | 针对精确编辑版本的复核记录 |
| governance/approvals/*.json | 真实人工批准的引用，不由构建生成 |
| governance/calibration/ | 非发布用冻结案例与测试变体 |
| governance/audits/ | 历史债务和结构审计，不是事实审核证书 |

JSON 对象摘要：UTF-8、ensure_ascii=False、sort_keys=True、separators=(',', ':') 后 SHA-256。文件摘要是原始字节 SHA-256。使用 `scripts/editorial_policy.digest`，不得拿 Git blob SHA 替代。

## Run

必填：`policyVersion`（字符串 2.4）、`runId`、`kind`（full/targeted/backfill）、`windowStart`、`windowEnd`、`evidenceCutoff`（均 YYYY-MM-DD）、`timezone`（UTC）、`baselineCommit`（40 位 SHA）、`operator`、`model`、`promptVersion`、`channels`、`categoryCoverage`、`candidates`。

- 非 full 要 `scopeReason`；full 要全部核心通道和六类覆盖。
- channel：`id/status/coverageNote/attempts`；非 complete 要 reason；partial/unavailable 要 retryResult；complete 要 windowCovered=true，且实际覆盖须由评审检查。
- attempt：`query/executedAt/artifact/sha256/resultCount`。时间为带时区 ISO 时间戳；文件限 governance/evidence 下。
- categoryCoverage：每项 `category/status/finding`。
- candidate：`candidateId/discoveryUrls/scores/scoreReasons/total/priority/decision/reason`。五个评分字段和五个理由字段必须完全匹配 policy。
- priority=skip/pool/confirm；decision=skip/hold/new/update/merge。最后三个要求 eventId 和 confirmation；优先级不足时补 priorityOverrideReason。
- confirmation：恰好 fact/impact/analysis/controversy，各含 `status/query/finding/evidenceIds`。found 不得为空；not_found/blocked 可空。
- directionDecisions（方向更新时）：每项 `id/decision/reason`，公开对象必须恰有一个 publish 决定。

## Source / 公开 editorial

新建或修改 Source 增加 `publisherId/originId/accessedAt`。originId 是主要信息起源，不能把转载 URL 自身当作独立起源。

v2.4 已审核/发布对象的 editorial 必填：

- `createdAt/updatedAt/reviewedAt/lastSourceCheckAt`（实际行为日期）。
- `curator/reviewer`（真实操作者，可是明确的 AI 会话标识，不等于人类批准）。
- `reviewProvenance: v2.4`、`reviewRecord`（governance/reviews 下的相对路径）。
- `changeLog` 非空：date/changeType/summary。
- 公开内容 `publishedAt` 保持首次记录日期。方向还需 `screeningRunId`。

新建 candidate/draft 只需基础数据结构，不要求编造复核/批准；reviewed 开始强制本契约。已有公开记录改变或归档不能退回 draft 来逃避审核。

## Review 公共字段

`policyVersion/policyDigest/kind/subjectId/subjectDigest/inputsDigest/evidenceCutoff/preparedBy/model/reviewedBy/reviewMethod/limitations/languageReview/evidence`。

policyDigest 绑定当前 policy 全对象；policy.rulesDigest 绑定规则总表的原始文件字节。因此规则正文改变也会使审核与批准失效，不能只沿用版本号。

- kind=event/arc/direction。
- inputsDigest=`review_inputs(kind, record, sources, events)`：绑定公开来源及 Arc/方向的锚点事件；依赖变更后旧复核失效。
- reviewMethod=independent_model/human/self_review。L2/L3 不允许仅 self_review。
- independent_model 还需不同的 producerSessionId/reviewerSessionId 和 reviewerModel。不同 actor 字符串不等于已真正独立，必须保存实际会话凭据供人工追溯。
- limitations 为非空字符串数组，哪怕只是明确“离线校验不能确认语义”。
- languageReview：factsAligned=true、notes，表示完成了实际的双语事实核对，不是机器自动测得。

### evidence 每项

`id/sourceId/claimId/url/originId/accessedAt/relationship/verification/quote/locator/artifact/sha256`。

- quote 是逐字文本，必须出现在留存文本中；截图/PDF 先形成可定位的文本摘录，并保存页码/章节定位。
- relationship=primary/independent/interested/unknown；verification=direct/independent_verification/reported/context。
- 每个事件 claim 都有证据，摘录 sourceIds 必须与 claim.sourceIds 相等；所有评审来源都应在公开 sources 引用中。
- 同一来源对不同 claim 的独立关系、验证对象可能不同，要分别记录。
- 访问和来源发布日期不晚于 evidenceCutoff。不能事后看了新材料却声称使用旧截止日。
- Arc 的 claimId 为稳定的章节/论点标识；来源可来自自身 sources 或锚点公开事件。方向的 signal 使用对应 signal.id 为 claimId，并匹配 sourceIds；基线/限制另设稳定标识。机器不验证这些文本的语义。

## Event 专属字段

- `runId/candidateId/runDigest`：匹配一个 selected candidate；截止日一致。
- `coreFactClaimIds`：明确节点身份所依赖的核心事实 claim；非空，均为 fact 且证据等级至少 B，不能用一个无关事实掩盖主事实不足。
- identity：`seriesId/action/stage/dateBasis/deduplicationReason/comparedEventIds/decision`。decision 与候选一致。
- classification：`primary/reason`；有次分类时 `secondaryClaimId` 指向确实不同的主张。
- significance：`rationale/whyNotHigher/whyNotLower/comparisonEventIds/routes`；至少两个其他已发布对照事件。
- route：`ruleId/criteria`。criteria 键集合与 policy 完全相同。
- criterion finding：`value/rationale/evidenceIds`。未知 value=null，可无证据；已知值需证据。布尔/计数不能混用。
- 组织/群体/后续工作计数：`entityIds` 数量必须等于 value；ID 指无关联控制主体/研究团队，而非同机构不同项目。人工验证独立性。
- observed_days：`observedSince/observedUntil`，由日期差复算。
- verified_active_users：`metric` 为 DAU/WAU/MAU、`measuredAt`；引用材料还须解释测量或估算方法。
- L3 significance 增加 `observedSince/observedUntil`，实证持续期达到配置，独立验证数量达标。
- L2 无一手资料时 `primaryUnavailableReason`；不能免除核心事实 B 级和路径验证。
- impactBasis 与 impacts **逐项同序**，各含 `dimension/observation/evidenceIds/observedSince/observedUntil/baseline/outcome/materialChange`；observation 只允许 observed。没有观察影响的 L1 两数组均空、impactIndex=0。
- consensus：`level/reason/evidenceIds`；broad 至少两组独立支持主要影响。
- dispute：`exists/reason/evidenceIds`；争议为真时有证据及 limitation claim。

## Arc / Direction 专属字段

两者都需要 `changeReason/counterEvidence/eventIds`；eventIds 恰好覆盖全部公开锚点。

方向另有 `screeningDecision: publish/consensusSearch/independentSourceIds/runId/runDigest`，关联 run.directionDecisions 及 editorial.screeningRunId。独立来源要有摘录支持且起源和控制主体均达到门槛。其余信号/共识/生命周期约束沿用正式 schema。

## Approval

路径：`governance/approvals/{subjectDigest}.json`。

必填：`subjectId/subjectDigest/reviewDigest/policyDigest/decision/actorType/actor/approvedAt/confirmationRef`。

- decision=approve，actorType=human；日期不早于 reviewedAt。
- reviewDigest 绑定 review 全对象，policyDigest 绑定 policy 全对象。审核内容或规则改变，旧批准不再生效。
- confirmationRef 指向实际确认消息或工单；程序不认证其真实性，项目负责人必须核对。
- 文件内不能写秘钥、会话 token 或不必要的个人信息。
- 归档已发布事件同样需要批准。旧基线未变的记录不要求追造历史批准。

## 可执行样例

完整合格与不合格样例由 `tests/test_editorial_policy.py` 在临时目录创建，均为明确的合成测试材料，不作为真实审核或批准入库。运行 `npm run test:editorial` 检查契约。禁止把测试证据/测试人工身份复制成生产审核。

    "en": "Microsoft took Tay offline in 2016 after it posted abusive content during user interactions. Three years later, OpenAI initially withheld GPT-2’s full model, citing concerns about misuse, and released versions in stages. The two episodes are not a controlled comparison: one concerns harmful outputs from a deployed chatbot; the other concerns a lab’s release decision for a language model. Together, they offer an early view of two responses—withdraw access after observed problems and restrict access ahead of anticipated misuse. Neither event by itself shows that either response became an industry standard or resolved the risks it addressed.",
    "zhHans": "2016 年，Tay 在与用户互动中发布冒犯性内容后，微软将其下线。三年后，OpenAI 以担忧模型遭滥用为由，起初没有发布 GPT-2 完整版本，而是分阶段开放。两件事并非可直接比较的实验：前者涉及已部署聊天机器人的有害输出，后者涉及实验室对语言模型的发布决定。它们展示了两种早期回应：问题出现后撤回访问，以及在预期风险前限制访问。单凭任何一件事，都不能证明相应做法后来成为行业标准或解决了所针对的风险。"

propriate safeguards ourselves and use the evidence we’d obtained about AI capabilities to advocate to other companies and governments that they take action as well. In other words, we believed that the capability thresholds might be good points at which to go beyond _unilateral_ action (Anthropic requiring safeguards for its own models) and encourage _multilateral_ action (other AI companies, and/or governments also requiring such safeguards).
*   _Looking to the future_. We recognized that, at some of the later capability thresholds, the intensity of countermeasures we were envisioning (for example, achieving high robustness against misuse of AI models by state-level actors) would likely be difficult or impossible for Anthropic to accomplish unilaterally. We hoped that by the time we reached these higher capabilities, the world would clearly see the dangers, and that we’d be able to coordinate with governments worldwide in implementing safeguards that are difficult for one company to achieve alone.

## Assessing our theory of change

Two and a half years later, our honest assessment is that some parts of this theory of change have played out as we hoped, but others have not. The following are the areas in which the RSP has been successful:

*   Our RSP **did**incentivize us to develop stronger safeguards. For example, in order to comply with our ASL-3 deployment standard (which is primarily about risks from chemical and biological weapons from threat actors with relatively modest resources and expertise), we developed increasingly sophisticated and accurate methods (specifically, [input and output classifiers](https://www.anthropic.com/research/constitutional-classifiers)) to block content of concern.

Next, the question is: Who will be required to comply with this bill? Regarding scoping, the Working Group recommends: 

Since policy may have different regulatory intents and existing thresholds vary in their profiles of determination time, measurability, and external verifiability, we agree with Nelson et al. However, the AI Act in Annex XIII affords the regulator flexibility to also consider alternative metrics, such as the number of parameters, size of the dataset, estimated cost or time of training, estimated energy consumption, benchmarks and evaluations of capabilities of the model, and whether the model has a high impact on the internal market due to its reach (either due to at least 10,000 registered business users or the number of registered end users). Further, to capture fast-moving scientific developments, the AI Act creates a scientific panel SB 53

that is empowered to issue qualified alerts to identify models that may pose systemic risk even if they are not captured by predefined quantitative thresholds. 

Overall, we emphasize that irrespective of the combination of metrics deemed most appropriate in the present, policymakers should ensure that mechanisms exist not only to update specific quantitative values, given the rapid pace of technological and societal change in AI, but also to change the metrics altogether. 35 

This bill draws inspiration from SB 1047, EU AI Act, and the Working Group report. Recent amendments have also substantially updated the scoping of this bill. These amendments establish a two-tiered system of requirements under the bill. First, a “frontier model” is defined as a model trained using 10²⁶ FLOP, a measure of computing power. Second, a “frontier developer” is defined as a person who has trained, or plans to train, a frontier model and who has access to the level of compute required to meet that threshold. The bill further defines a “large frontier developer” as a frontier developer whose gross revenue exceeded $500 million in the previous year. This tiered framework allows for the bill to place more stringent transparency obligations, outlined in the transparency section, on the better-resourced large frontier developers, while still ensuring that all frontier developers remain subject to baseline transparency and reporting requirements as well as whistleblower protections. 

Recent amendments have also revised how this bill builds flexibility into its scope. # Media  Statement 

X FAILS TO IMPLEMENT SA FEGUARDS, MCMC ORDERS TEMPORARY 

RESTRICTIONS ON GROK 

CYBERJAYA, 11 January 2026  – The Malaysian Communications and Multimedia 

Commission (MCMC) has directed a temporary restriction on access to the Grok 

artificial intelligence for users in Malaysia, effective 11 January 2026. 

This action follows repeated misuse of Grok to generate obscene, sexually 

explicit, indecent, grossly offensive, and non -consensual manipulated images, 

including content involving women and minors, despite prior regulatory 

engagement and formal notices iss ued to X Corp. and xAI LLC. 

MCMC had issued notices to X Corp. and xAI LLC on 3 January 2026 and 8 January 

2026 to demand, amongst others, the implementation of effective technical and 

moderation safeguards to prevent AI -generated content that may contravene 

Malaysian law, including  Section 233 of the Communications and Multimedia Act 

1998. 

However, the responses submitted on 7 January 2026 and 9 January 2026 by X 

Corp. relied primarily on user -initiated reporting mechanisms and failed to 

address the inherent risks posed by the design and operation of the AI tool. 

MCMC considers this insufficient to prevent harm or ensure legal compliance. 

Accordingly, the restriction is imposed as a preventive and proportionate 

measure while legal and regulatory processes are ongoing. Access to Grok will 

remain restricted until effective safeguards are implemented, particularly to 

prevent content involving  women and children. MCMC remains open to 

engagement with X Corp. and xAI LLC subject to demonstrable compliance with 

Malaysian law. 2

Members of the public are strongly urged to promptly report harmful online 

content to MCMC and, where appropriate, lodge police reports with the Royal 

Malaysia Police. 

MCMC  CORPORATE COMMUNICATIONS

## Potential Misuse and Security Risks

The heavy sharing on GitHub (thousands of forks, stars, and mirrors by developers worldwide) turns this into a vector for abuse. Key risks include:

1.   **Supply chain attacks via malicious forks and mirrors:** Thousands of repositories now host the leaked code or derivatives. Threat actors can (and already are) seeding trojanized versions with backdoors, data exfiltrators, or cryptominers. Unsuspecting users cloning “official-looking” forks risks immediate compromise.
2.   **Amplified exploitation of known vulnerabilities and discovery of new vulnerabilities:** Pre-existing flaws (e.g., CVE-2025-59536, CVE-2026-21852, RCE and API key exfiltration via malicious repo configs, hooks, MCP servers, and env vars) are now far easier to weaponize. Threat actors with full source visibility can craft precise malicious repositories or project files that trigger arbitrary shell execution or credential theft simply by cloning/opening an untrusted repo. The exposed hook and permission logic makes silent device takeover more reliable.
3.   **Local environment and developer workstation compromise:** Users building or running the leaked code locally introduce unvetted dependencies and execution paths. The leak coincided exactly with a [separate malicious Axios](https://www.zscaler.com/blogs/security-research/supply-chain-attacks-surge-march-2026)`npm` supply chain attack (RATs published March 31, 00:21–03:29 UTC), creating a perfect storm for anyone updating Claude Code via npm that day.

## ThreatLabz discovers “Claude Code leak” lure that distributes Vidar and GhostSocks

While monitoring GitHub for threats, ThreatLabz came across a “Claude Code leak” repository published by idbzoomh (links located in the IOC section). The repository looks like it’s trying to pass itself off as leaked TypeScript source code for Anthropic’s Claude Code CLI. The README file even claims the code was exposed through a `.map` file in the npm package and then rebuilt into a working fork with “unlocked” enterprise features and no message limits.

The repository link appears near the top of Google results for searches like “leaked Claude Code,” which makes it easy for curious users to encounter, as shown in the figure below.

![Image 6: Google search results for leaked Claude Code on GitHub returning a malicious repository.](https://cms.zscaler.com/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto/sites/default/files/images/blogs/1_14.png)

URL Source: https://www.myfloridalegal.com/newsrelease/attorney-general-james-uthmeier-files-first-nation-state-led-lawsuit-against-openai-ceo

Release Date

Phone

![Image 1](https://www.myfloridalegal.com/sites/default/files/2026-03/dsc06064.jpg)

_Courtesy of the Office of the Attorney General_

**TALLAHASSEE, Fla**.—Attorney General James Uthmeier announced legal action against OpenAI and its Chief Executive Officer, Sam Altman, alleging that the company knowingly released and aggressively marketed ChatGPT to the public—including to children—while concealing serious risks, suppressing internal safety warnings, and deceiving Floridians about the true nature and dangers of the product.

“Today, we announced the first-in-the-nation state-led lawsuit against OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman,” **said Attorney General James Uthmeier.** “OpenAI and Altman ignored internal and external safety warnings, put children at great risk, and allowed a dangerous product to reach millions of Floridians.”

“Today’s AI companies have largely assisted with the evolution of the digital playground. Protecting our children means teaching them to navigate not just the real people behind the screens, but the artificial minds engineered to mimic them,” **said FDLE Special Agent in Charge Mike Duffey.** “Parental vigilance must shift from simply monitoring who our children talk to, to ensuring they understand what they are talking to—because a machine programmed to please can never replace the safety of human boundaries.”

The civil complaint alleges that OpenAI and Altman prioritized speed to market and commercial gain over user safety, disregarded repeated warnings from experts both inside and outside the company, and deployed a product that facilitates and encourages harm—including self-harm and violence—while falsely assuring users it was safe.

The complaint also alleges that ChatGPT collects data from minors without meaningful parental oversight, causes behavioral addiction and cognitive harm, and is prone to dangerous errors that the company has actively downplayed.

Florida law prohibits unfair and defective trade practices. The complaint alleges that OpenAI’s conduct causes ongoing harm to Floridians and demands accountability. The State seeks damages on behalf of the people of Florida and an end to the deceptive and dangerous practices outlined in the complaint.

Last month, the Office of Statewide Prosecution [launched a criminal investigation](https://www.myfloridalegal.com/newsrelease/attorney-general-james-uthmeier-launches-criminal-investigation-openai-chatgpt) after prosecutors reviewed chat logs between ChatGPT and Phoenix Ikner, the gunman who opened fire at Florida State University on April 17, 2025, claiming two lives and injuring several others. The criminal investigation is ongoing.

To read the full complaint as filed in the Tenth Judicial Circuit of Florida, click [here](https://www.myfloridalegal.com/sites/default/files/openai-filed-stamped-complaint.pdf).

Published on October 15, 2026

The attorneys general of[Arizona](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Arizona.pdf),[Arkansas](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Arkansas.pdf),[Idaho](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Idaho.pdf),[Iowa](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Iowa.pdf),[Kansas](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Kansas.pdf),[Montana](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Montana.pdf),[Nebraska](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Nebraska.pdf), and[West Virginia](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/West-Virginia.pdf) filed coordinated lawsuits against OpenAI in their own state courts on Oct. 14. The narrative explicitly cautions that these two events are not a controlled comparison (deployed chatbot harmful output vs. pre-deployment model withholding) and explicitly observes that neither event proved that either approach became an industry-wide standard or permanently solved underlying risks.

- 两个节点重复描述同一动作：提出 merge 方案；合并涉及旧 URL 时先做迁移审核，不直接删除。
- 调查/起诉是程序事实，不等于认定违法；计划/签约不等于完成；可用不等于采用；开源公告不等于已开放权重。

**IDENT-02 / MUST**：日期取节点所述动作真实发生日；只知披露日就将节点定义为披露。保留 day/month/year 的证据精度，不制造 1 日。不再凭“普通人感知到的时刻”挑热度峰值。`evidenceCutoff` 是本轮可用证据截止日，允许后来的真实影响支持历史事件的回顾评级，不能伪称当年已经可知。

**CLASS-01 / MUST**：主分类按节点的核心动作，而不是评级或品牌：方法/能力→capability；产品可用性/使用方式→product；资本/所有权/市场结构→commerce；立法/监管/裁判→governance；事故/风险治理实践→safety；有证据的社会行为→society。法院动作即使源于事故仍主归 governance；事故节点主归 safety；融资不因为投向芯片变成 capability。

**CLASS-02 / MUST**：最多一个次分类，必须绑定一个不同于主分类核心事实的、独立成句且有来源的 claim。删去这个 claim 会丢失一个实际变化，才保留次分类。废止不可测的“30% 信息丢失”标准。多个合理主分类仍并列时：按节点标题动作选择；不能确定则在评审中解决，不能用数组顺序随机表达。

## 3. 证据链

**EVID-01 / MUST**：每个 claim 都绑定逐字摘录、定位信息、URL、实际访问日期、文本留存文件哈希和 claim-local originId。哈希证明本地文件未变，不证明网页真实性。保留必要上下文；不把搜索摘要作为已读全文。付费/失效/无权限记 blocked，优先找原始材料或可靠存档，不能填造摘录。

**EVID-02 / MUST**：Tier 评价来源性质；A–D 评价这条主张的证明力度。publisherId 对同控制主体去重；originId 对同原始信息起源去重。转载同一公司新闻稿、两个媒体复述同一厂商跑分，不是两次验证。来源默认 originId 可记录整篇主要起源，摘录级 originId 用于混合来源稿件。关系分 primary/independent/interested/unknown，验证分 direct/independent_verification/reported/context。

**EVID-03 / MUST**：证据等级上限：

- A：原始直接材料＋不同起源/控制主体的独立验证；或至少两组独立验证。仅“报道了有该公告”不验证性能。
- B：可靠 Tier 1 直接支持；或两个不同起源、不同控制主体的独立 Tier 2。
- C：可靠单一独立二手支持；不能升级为已经独立复现。
- D：只有传闻、未核实营销、百科背景或未知链条。不能支撑公开事实/影响。

百科可用于背景，不独立满足发布证据门槛。厂商公告可以直接证明“厂商宣称 X”，不能直接证明“X 性能优于 Y”。每条核心事实至少 B。L2 还必须满足对应变化路径；缺一手材料时须说明原因，核心事实仍需两个独立 Tier 2。L3 必须有原始材料及规定数量的独立起源，核心转折不得依赖 C。

## 4. 历史重要度

**SIG-01 / MUST**：先确认事实，再评历史意义；不以融资额、厂商声量、新闻数量、模型参数或初筛总分直接指定 L2。L1 不代表“不重要”，只表示目前未证明符合更高等级。没有等级比例配额。

**SIG-02 / MUST**：依次检验相关路径；每项填写 true/false/数值/**null（未知）**、理由和证据。null 不等于反证；false 必须有支持该否定的材料。至少检查一个相关路径；不能为空列表规避判断。

| ruleId | 已发生的变化（所有条件 AND；不同路径 OR） | 独立验证对象 |
|---|---|---|
| L2-CAPABILITY | 明确此前不可行的任务、同条件基线、外部复测或可审计的独立任务裁判 | 任务结果；不要求从头重训模型，小幅榜单提分不自动算新任务 |
| L2-METHOD | 可复用的新方法/框架，规定数量的无关联后续工作实际采用 | 后续采用，不是纯引用计数 |
| L2-PRODUCT | 新工作流，规定数量的无关联组织在真实生产使用 | 实際使用，不是 logo、合作公告或试点意向 |
| L2-PRODUCT-ACCESS | 实质改变使用/再分发权限或可达性，规定数量的无关联生产采用 | 许可/可用性变化及采用；只是降价不自动成立 |
| L2-PRODUCT-SCALE | 新工作流，达到规定活跃用户数 | 注明 DAU/WAU/MAU、日期、估计方法；不以累计注册/下载替代 |
| L2-COMMERCE | 所有权、供需组织或交易规则的结构变化已执行，并影响规定数量的外部主体 | 交易两方外的已发生变化；融资/估值/产能规划本身不够 |
| L2-GOVERNANCE | 有约束力或先例效力的行为，适用超出具名当事人，有独立法律分析 | 适用范围/效力；一般提案、立案或索取资料不够 |
| L2-SAFETY | 有记录事故、外部实际补救行动、独立调查 | 调查发现；只有当事方自述报告不够 |
| L2-SAFETY-PRACTICE | 新安全实践，规定数量的无关联组织实际在生产采用 | 执行情况；承诺/评估框架发布不够 |
| L2-SOCIETY | 测得行为变化、规定数量独立人群及持续观察时长 | 行为与人群，不是搜索热度或短期话题 |

“新工作流”须描述旧流程→新流程，任务完成方式或参与者责任确实变化；“结构变化”须描述旧结构→新结构，而非只有规模增加。阈值的精确数字只维护在 policy.json。它们是**编辑政策，不是自然定律或预测实现标准**。

**SIG-03 / MUST**：L2 至少满足一个路径；L3 至少满足 policy 指定的不同类别数、观察期及独立起源数，并解释相互关联的跨领域持续变化。时间跨度长不等于持续观察；不能用“事件发生至今很多年”填观察期。否则最高可支持 L2。L3 不是 impactIndex 达到某个分数的别名。

**SIG-04 / MUST**：评审记录包括“已改变什么”“为何不是更低/更高”“至少两个已发布对照事件”。对照仅比较事实阶段、证据和变化类型，不照抄历史等级。旧证据包不足时输出“无法重评/待补证”，不能直接宣判降级。分歧不取平均：先比较证据截止日和未知项，再复核路径；解决不了则保留旧公开级别并阻止本轮评级变更。

## 5. 影响分、共识和争议

**IMP-01 / MUST**：影响只计已观察到的后果。尚未发生的潜在影响可以作为明确标注的 interpretation/open question，不进入影响指数。L1 尚无可核实影响时允许 impacts=[]、impactIndex=0；不为凑齐结构捏造影响。L2/L3 仍需影响条目和 impact claim。

**IMP-02 / MUST**：严重度按绝对值逐级检验：0=实测无方向性变化；1=有方向但未达到实质变化；2=证据支持工作流/权利/成本/风险暴露/行为等具体基线发生实质改变；3=满足 2 且达到政策规定受众广度与持续观察期。正负分别记录；风险的“存在”与损害的“发生”不能互换。记录 baseline/outcome/materialChange，严禁用情绪形容词代替。

**IMP-03 / MUST**：受众只用 policy 中互斥程度尽可能高的角色 ID；同一主体承担不同已证实角色才可重复跨组计入。developers 不得改写成 programmers/coders 分别加分。每个 impact 独立记录观察起止日；timeframe 由天数阈值计算，不由预测持续时间决定。0–29/30–179/180–364/365+ 天对应当前四档，精确值以配置为准。短期观察不得借长期预期拿耐久加分。

**IMP-04 / MUST**：保留 v2.3 公式及四舍五入方式，见 DATA-MODEL；不静默改写历史分数。它是影响量级摘要，不是概率、质量或有益程度；负向严重后果同样增加绝对影响。现公式理论最高舍入为 9（各项上限总和 9），0–10 是字段取值边界而非保证覆盖的量表；不得人工凑 10。

**CONS-01 / MUST**：emerging=主要影响证据仍积累；debated=存在有证据的规模/归因/解释分歧；broad=主要影响有至少两组独立支持且无未解决的实质反证。仅事实发布获得多家报道不能叫 broad。controversy 标记具体争议的存在，不是 emerging 的同义词；所有等级的 controversy=true 均需 limitation claim 和相应证据。

## 6. Arc、方向与语言

**ARC-01 / MUST**：Arc 只引用已发布事件，按 ARC-MODEL 的章节/时间跨度要求。章节论点是可辩论的编辑解释，不能新增未经核实事实；每个新增重要判断在 review 中留证据和反例。引用事件或来源变化时复核受影响章节；不得为了“有立场”编造因果。

**DIR-01 / MUST**：方向仍按 POSSIBLE-DIRECTIONS-SCREENING：至少两个公开事件、两个有事实锚点的 observed signals、独立来源与反向约束。run 中方向决定和 editorial.screeningRunId 必须连通。默认 monitor_only；外部共识证据不足时不能用事件评级的内部数值门槛宣布方向实现。

**LANG-01 / MUST**：中英文共享同一事实/主张台账，主体、数字、单位、日期、条件、否定、不确定性强度必须一致；任何语言都不享有“事实优先权”。可以从原始材料先写任一语言，也可以并行写作；不得为了自然表达增加事实。事件 summary 事实先行，Arc 可论点先行但必须有证据，方向区分当前基线与尚未成为常态的可能变化。

**LANG-02 / SHOULD**：句式、长度、修辞建议不是事实门禁。不得把某个“把/让/了”字或首句句法视为自动退稿理由；应检查主语、因果和证据是否清楚。语言人工复核与机械结构检查分开报告。

## 7. 完成标准与覆盖边界

- 规则完成：权威入口、阶段合同、含未知的评级分支、冲突处理、证据/审批/历史例外都有明确路径。
- 实现完成：正反例涵盖常规可发布、信息不足、证据来源混同、过期批准、错误引用、历史豁免绕过、影响重复计分及方向/Arc 边界。
- 校准完成：冻结案例与反事实样本，标注哪些是原有数据、哪些是测试构造；记录规则改动理由。**不等于旧事件已事实重审。**
- 跨模型验收：独立会话使用同一冻结证据、同一政策、同一提示词；对照 [CALIBRATION](CALIBRATION.md) 计算一致率、覆盖率和硬规则违规。未实测不得说已达标。

机械校验能查：字段/枚举/阈值/引用/日期/文件与摘要/证据上限/批准绑定。
机械校验不能查：摘录语义是否真的证明结论、组织是否真正无关联、是否完整发现候选、语言是否自然、人工批准是否真实、因果归因是否充分。上述 MUST 仍是评审职责，不因自动通过而免除。


===== ARC MODEL =====
# EpochArc 专题叙事标准 v2.4

规则边界：[EDITORIAL-STANDARD](../workflow/EDITORIAL-STANDARD.md) ARC-01、LANG-01/02。结构继承现有构建器，新增审核使用 [REVIEW-CONTRACT](../data/REVIEW-CONTRACT.md)。

## 1. 定位

Arc 将已发布事件组织成可阅读、可辩论的解释线索，不是新闻堆叠，也不是为了“锋利”而制造立场。

合格选题须有：

- 明确问题或可检验论点。
- 足够的已发布事件支持。
- 能指出反例、限制或替代解释。
- 判断力度不超过证据。

允许编辑解释，但应区分事实、归因与推测。中立不等于不作判断；有立场也不等于可以忽略反证。

## 2. 常见结构（SHOULD，不限制新结构）

| 结构 | 目标 |
|---|---|
| 技术演进 | 解释方法、约束与选择如何演化 |
| 主题线索 | 围绕安全、治理、开放性等跨事件问题 |
| 社会变化 | 从受影响人群的可观察行为组织事件 |
| 竞争路线 | 比较不同方案的证据、收益和限制，不预设赢家 |

不要求每章刻意反直觉，也不要求把仍有争议的问题写成确定答案。

## 3. MUST：数据结构

唯一编辑源 `content/arcs/*.json`；`data/arcs.json`、`arcs/{id}/index.html` 是构建输出。

每条含 id/title/subtitle/abstract/chapters/conclusion/status/editorial；文本为完整 en/zhHans。

- 3–6 章，每章 id/title/narrative/anchorEvents/keyInsight。
- 每章 2–5 个不重复的已发布锚点事件。
- 全文至少 5 个不同锚点事件。
- 最晚与最早事件年份差至少 3，沿用当前机械口径；不是用单月合集冒充长期演变。
- relatedArcs 不能自引、重复或引用未发布专题。
- 日期范围、分类和覆盖数量从锚点派生，不维护第二套数字。

## 4. MUST：论证与证据

- 每章有明确的论点或问题；可以论点先行，不受事件 summary 首句事实模板约束。
- 用锚点中的事实支持解释，不把锚点链接当成对所有新判断的兜底引用。
- 新增重要事实先按事件事实标准核实；新增重要解释在 review.evidence 中记录摘录、来源、章节/论点标识。
- 至少处理一个实质反例或替代解释，review.counterEvidence 记录检索结果；找不到时说明已查范围，不能虚构反方。
- 结语可以给出有限结论或尚未解决的问题，不强制预测市场赢家。
- 同一事件在不同 Arc 可以有不同解释，但不能出现相互冲突的未经说明的事实版本。

## 5. 双语与文风

中英文共享事实/主张台账。允许先写任一语言或并行写作；不得强制“中文不能看英文”，也不得强制“英文永远为准”。最终核对主体、数字、时点、因果、限制和不确定性，不要求逐句镜像。

建议英文 abstract 40–60 词、章节 narrative 100–200 词、conclusion 60–100 词；中文按自然信息量调整。这些是 SHOULD，不是牺牲事实边界的硬字数。

避免空洞自我介绍和营销语言。可用主动或被动句，以责任主体明确为先；不得为避免被动语态将“validated”自动改成更强的“proved”。

## 6. 复核与发布

1. 检查全部锚点为 published，章节结构与派生元数据正确。
2. review.eventIds 覆盖所有锚点；inputsDigest 绑定锚点及其公开来源，防止引用内容已变而复核仍称有效。
3. review 记录 changeReason/counterEvidence、证据、双语核对、操作者及实际日期。
4. 精确版本人工批准，运行统一校验、测试、构建。
5. 本地检查 TOC、事件链接、canonical/hreflang、两种语言及样式；生成页面不手改。
6. 无明确授权不 push。事件或来源改变时，重新检查受影响章节并更新对应 review/approval。

程序可检查引用与结构，不能证明论点有说服力或因果成立；这部分由证据复核负责。


===== REVIEW CONTRACT =====
# v2.4 编辑证据与审批契约

规则语义见 [EDITORIAL-STANDARD](../workflow/EDITORIAL-STANDARD.md)。公开数据结构沿用 DATA-MODEL；新增审计材料放在 `governance/`，不复制到公开 data 目录。不为旧数据补造审核。

## 文件组织

| 路径 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| governance/policy.json | 版本化参数，不是公开方向的实现标准 |
| governance/legacy-baseline.json | 一次性历史内容指纹；禁止重新生成以绕过门禁 |
| governance/runs/*.json | 新批次，包含发现/筛选及方向决定 |
| governance/evidence/* | 实际采集的文本/响应摘录，可分子目录 |
| governance/reviews/*.json | 针对精确编辑版本的复核记录 |
| governance/approvals/*.json | 真实人工批准的引用，不由构建生成 |
| governance/calibration/ | 非发布用冻结案例与测试变体 |
| governance/audits/ | 历史债务和结构审计，不是事实审核证书 |

JSON 对象摘要：UTF-8、ensure_ascii=False、sort_keys=True、separators=(',', ':') 后 SHA-256。文件摘要是原始字节 SHA-256。使用 `scripts/editorial_policy.digest`，不得拿 Git blob SHA 替代。

## Run

必填：`policyVersion`（字符串 2.4）、`runId`、`kind`（full/targeted/backfill）、`windowStart`、`windowEnd`、`evidenceCutoff`（均 YYYY-MM-DD）、`timezone`（UTC）、`baselineCommit`（40 位 SHA）、`operator`、`model`、`promptVersion`、`channels`、`categoryCoverage`、`candidates`。

- 非 full 要 `scopeReason`；full 要全部核心通道和六类覆盖。
- channel：`id/status/coverageNote/attempts`；非 complete 要 reason；partial/unavailable 要 retryResult；complete 要 windowCovered=true，且实际覆盖须由评审检查。
- attempt：`query/executedAt/artifact/sha256/resultCount`。时间为带时区 ISO 时间戳；文件限 governance/evidence 下。
- categoryCoverage：每项 `category/status/finding`。
- candidate：`candidateId/discoveryUrls/scores/scoreReasons/total/priority/decision/reason`。五个评分字段和五个理由字段必须完全匹配 policy。
- priority=skip/pool/confirm；decision=skip/hold/new/update/merge。最后三个要求 eventId 和 confirmation；优先级不足时补 priorityOverrideReason。
- confirmation：恰好 fact/impact/analysis/controversy，各含 `status/query/finding/evidenceIds`。found 不得为空；not_found/blocked 可空。
- directionDecisions（方向更新时）：每项 `id/decision/reason`，公开对象必须恰有一个 publish 决定。

## Source / 公开 editorial

新建或修改 Source 增加 `publisherId/originId/accessedAt`。originId 是主要信息起源，不能把转载 URL 自身当作独立起源。

v2.4 已审核/发布对象的 editorial 必填：

- `createdAt/updatedAt/reviewedAt/lastSourceCheckAt`（实际行为日期）。
- `curator/reviewer`（真实操作者，可是明确的 AI 会话标识，不等于人类批准）。
- `reviewProvenance: v2.4`、`reviewRecord`（governance/reviews 下的相对路径）。
- `changeLog` 非空：date/changeType/summary。
- 公开内容 `publishedAt` 保持首次记录日期。方向还需 `screeningRunId`。

新建 candidate/draft 只需基础数据结构，不要求编造复核/批准；reviewed 开始强制本契约。已有公开记录改变或归档不能退回 draft 来逃避审核。

## Review 公共字段

`policyVersion/policyDigest/kind/subjectId/subjectDigest/inputsDigest/evidenceCutoff/preparedBy/model/reviewedBy/reviewMethod/limitations/languageReview/evidence`。

policyDigest 绑定当前 policy 全对象；policy.rulesDigest 绑定规则总表的原始文件字节。因此规则正文改变也会使审核与批准失效，不能只沿用版本号。

- kind=event/arc/direction。
- inputsDigest=`review_inputs(kind, record, sources, events)`：绑定公开来源及 Arc/方向的锚点事件；依赖变更后旧复核失效。
- reviewMethod=independent_model/human/self_review。L2/L3 不允许仅 self_review。
- independent_model 还需不同的 producerSessionId/reviewerSessionId 和 reviewerModel。不同 actor 字符串不等于已真正独立，必须保存实际会话凭据供人工追溯。
- limitations 为非空字符串数组，哪怕只是明确“离线校验不能确认语义”。
- languageReview：factsAligned=true、notes，表示完成了实际的双语事实核对，不是机器自动测得。

### evidence 每项

`id/sourceId/claimId/url/originId/accessedAt/relationship/verification/quote/locator/artifact/sha256`。

- quote 是逐字文本，必须出现在留存文本中；截图/PDF 先形成可定位的文本摘录，并保存页码/章节定位。
- relationship=primary/independent/interested/unknown；verification=direct/independent_verification/reported/context。
- 每个事件 claim 都有证据，摘录 sourceIds 必须与 claim.sourceIds 相等；所有评审来源都应在公开 sources 引用中。
- 同一来源对不同 claim 的独立关系、验证对象可能不同，要分别记录。
- 访问和来源发布日期不晚于 evidenceCutoff。不能事后看了新材料却声称使用旧截止日。
- Arc 的 claimId 为稳定的章节/论点标识；来源可来自自身 sources 或锚点公开事件。方向的 signal 使用对应 signal.id 为 claimId，并匹配 sourceIds；基线/限制另设稳定标识。机器不验证这些文本的语义。

## Event 专属字段

- `runId/candidateId/runDigest`：匹配一个 selected candidate；截止日一致。
- `coreFactClaimIds`：明确节点身份所依赖的核心事实 claim；非空，均为 fact 且证据等级至少 B，不能用一个无关事实掩盖主事实不足。
- identity：`seriesId/action/stage/dateBasis/deduplicationReason/comparedEventIds/decision`。decision 与候选一致。
- classification：`primary/reason`；有次分类时 `secondaryClaimId` 指向确实不同的主张。
- significance：`rationale/whyNotHigher/whyNotLower/comparisonEventIds/routes`；至少两个其他已发布对照事件。
- route：`ruleId/criteria`。criteria 键集合与 policy 完全相同。
- criterion finding：`value/rationale/evidenceIds`。未知 value=null，可无证据；已知值需证据。布尔/计数不能混用。
- 组织/群体/后续工作计数：`entityIds` 数量必须等于 value；ID 指无关联控制主体/研究团队，而非同机构不同项目。人工验证独立性。
- observed_days：`observedSince/observedUntil`，由日期差复算。
- verified_active_users：`metric` 为 DAU/WAU/MAU、`measuredAt`；引用材料还须解释测量或估算方法。
- L3 significance 增加 `observedSince/observedUntil`，实证持续期达到配置，独立验证数量达标。
- L2 无一手资料时 `primaryUnavailableReason`；不能免除核心事实 B 级和路径验证。
- impactBasis 与 impacts **逐项同序**，各含 `dimension/observation/evidenceIds/observedSince/observedUntil/baseline/outcome/materialChange`；observation 只允许 observed。没有观察影响的 L1 两数组均空、impactIndex=0。
- consensus：`level/reason/evidenceIds`；broad 至少两组独立支持主要影响。
- dispute：`exists/reason/evidenceIds`；争议为真时有证据及 limitation claim。

## Arc / Direction 专属字段

两者都需要 `changeReason/counterEvidence/eventIds`；eventIds 恰好覆盖全部公开锚点。

方向另有 `screeningDecision: publish/consensusSearch/independentSourceIds/runId/runDigest`，关联 run.directionDecisions 及 editorial.screeningRunId。独立来源要有摘录支持且起源和控制主体均达到门槛。其余信号/共识/生命周期约束沿用正式 schema。

## Approval

路径：`governance/approvals/{subjectDigest}.json`。

必填：`subjectId/subjectDigest/reviewDigest/policyDigest/decision/actorType/actor/approvedAt/confirmationRef`。

- decision=approve，actorType=human；日期不早于 reviewedAt。
- reviewDigest 绑定 review 全对象，policyDigest 绑定 policy 全对象。审核内容或规则改变，旧批准不再生效。
- confirmationRef 指向实际确认消息或工单；程序不认证其真实性，项目负责人必须核对。
- 文件内不能写秘钥、会话 token 或不必要的个人信息。
- 归档已发布事件同样需要批准。旧基线未变的记录不要求追造历史批准。

## 可执行样例

完整合格与不合格样例由 `tests/test_editorial_policy.py` 在临时目录创建，均为明确的合成测试材料，不作为真实审核或批准入库。运行 `npm run test:editorial` 检查契约。禁止把测试证据/测试人工身份复制成生产审核。

It also marked the first time ordinary people heard the argument that AI could be too dangerous to release, permanently changing how the public thought about AI risk.",
    "zhHans": "2019 年 2 月 14 日，OpenAI 发布了 GPT-2，一个能够生成极其连贯文本的语言模型。但 OpenAI 没有完全发布它，而是以\"对恶意应用的担忧\"为由扣留了完整模型。这一决定引发了一场激烈的全球辩论：OpenAI 是谨慎负责还是在吸引眼球？分阶段发布——在数月内逐步发布越来越大的版本——成了 AI 安全披露的模板。这也标志着普通人第一次听到\"AI 可能危险到不宜发布\"的论点，永久改变了公众对 AI 风险的看法。"
  },
  "narrative": {
    "en": "GPT-2 was a significant leap forward in text generation. With 1.5 billion parameters, it could write news articles, stories, and dialogue that were difficult to distinguish from human writing. OpenAI's blog post included samples — including the famous 'unicorn story' — that went viral. But the headline was the refusal to release the full model. OpenAI's decision was controversial within the AI community. Critics argued that the staged release was a publicity stunt — GPT-2 was impressive but not revolutionary, and withholding the model was overblown. Supporters countered that the paper had already demonstrated the model's ability to generate convincing fake news, spam, and impersonations, and that responsible disclosure was essential. The debate itself became the story, generating front-page coverage in major newspapers. The staged release unfolded over nine months: February 2019 (small 124M model), May 2019 (medium 355M), August 2019 (large 774M), and finally November 2019 (full 1.5B model). By the time the full model was released, no catastrophic misuse had occurred — but the precedent was set. ## Potential Misuse and Security Risks

The heavy sharing on GitHub (thousands of forks, stars, and mirrors by developers worldwide) turns this into a vector for abuse. Key risks include:

1.   **Supply chain attacks via malicious forks and mirrors:** Thousands of repositories now host the leaked code or derivatives. Threat actors can (and already are) seeding trojanized versions with backdoors, data exfiltrators, or cryptominers. Unsuspecting users cloning “official-looking” forks risks immediate compromise.
2.   **Amplified exploitation of known vulnerabilities and discovery of new vulnerabilities:** Pre-existing flaws (e.g., CVE-2025-59536, CVE-2026-21852, RCE and API key exfiltration via malicious repo configs, hooks, MCP servers, and env vars) are now far easier to weaponize. Threat actors with full source visibility can craft precise malicious repositories or project files that trigger arbitrary shell execution or credential theft simply by cloning/opening an untrusted repo. The exposed hook and permission logic makes silent device takeover more reliable.
3.   **Local environment and developer workstation compromise:** Users building or running the leaked code locally introduce unvetted dependencies and execution paths. The leak coincided exactly with a [separate malicious Axios](https://www.zscaler.com/blogs/security-research/supply-chain-attacks-surge-march-2026)`npm` supply chain attack (RATs published March 31, 00:21–03:29 UTC), creating a perfect storm for anyone updating Claude Code via npm that day.

## ThreatLabz discovers “Claude Code leak” lure that distributes Vidar and GhostSocks

While monitoring GitHub for threats, ThreatLabz came across a “Claude Code leak” repository published by idbzoomh (links located in the IOC section). The repository looks like it’s trying to pass itself off as leaked TypeScript source code for Anthropic’s Claude Code CLI. The README file even claims the code was exposed through a `.map` file in the npm package and then rebuilt into a working fork with “unlocked” enterprise features and no message limits.

The repository link appears near the top of Google results for searches like “leaked Claude Code,” which makes it easy for curious users to encounter, as shown in the figure below.

![Image 6: Google search results for leaked Claude Code on GitHub returning a malicious repository.](https://cms.zscaler.com/cdn-cgi/image/format=auto/sites/default/files/images/blogs/1_14.png)

Title: Attorney General James Uthmeier Files First-in-the-Nation State-Led Lawsuit Against OpenAI, CEO Sam Altman for Deceptive Practices and Harms to Floridians

URL Source: https://www.myfloridalegal.com/newsrelease/attorney-general-james-uthmeier-files-first-nation-state-led-lawsuit-against-openai-ceo

Published Time: Sat, 17 Oct 2026 00:39:48 GMT

Markdown Content:
Release Date

Phone

(850) 245-0150

![Image 1](https://www.myfloridalegal.com/sites/default/files/2026-03/dsc06064.jpg)

_Courtesy of the Office of the Attorney General_

**TALLAHASSEE, Fla**.—Attorney General James Uthmeier announced legal action against OpenAI and its Chief Executive Officer, Sam Altman, alleging that the company knowingly released and aggressively marketed ChatGPT to the public—including to children—while concealing serious risks, suppressing internal safety warnings, and deceiving Floridians about the true nature and dangers of the product.

“Today, we announced the first-in-the-nation state-led lawsuit against OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman,” **said Attorney General James Uthmeier.** “OpenAI and Altman ignored internal and external safety warnings, put children at great risk, and allowed a dangerous product to reach millions of Floridians.”

“Today’s AI companies have largely assisted with the evolution of the digital playground. Protecting our children means teaching them to navigate not just the real people behind the screens, but the artificial minds engineered to mimic them,” **said FDLE Special Agent in Charge Mike Duffey.** “Parental vigilance must shift from simply monitoring who our children talk to, to ensuring they understand what they are talking to—because a machine programmed to please can never replace the safety of human boundaries.”

The civil complaint alleges that OpenAI and Altman prioritized speed to market and commercial gain over user safety, disregarded repeated warnings from experts both inside and outside the company, and deployed a product that facilitates and encourages harm—including self-harm and violence—while falsely assuring users it was safe.

The complaint also alleges that ChatGPT collects data from minors without meaningful parental oversight, causes behavioral addiction and cognitive harm, and is prone to dangerous errors that the company has actively downplayed.

Florida law prohibits unfair and defective trade practices. The complaint alleges that OpenAI’s conduct causes ongoing harm to Floridians and demands accountability. The State seeks damages on behalf of the people of Florida and an end to the deceptive and dangerous practices outlined in the complaint.

Last month, the Office of Statewide Prosecution [launched a criminal investigation](https://www.myfloridalegal.com/newsrelease/attorney-general-james-uthmeier-launches-criminal-investigation-openai-chatgpt) after prosecutors reviewed chat logs between ChatGPT and Phoenix Ikner, the gunman who opened fire at Florida State University on April 17, 2025, claiming two lives and injuring several others. The criminal investigation is ongoing.

To read the full complaint as filed in the Tenth Judicial Circuit of Florida, click [here](https://www.myfloridalegal.com/sites/default/files/openai-filed-stamped-complaint.pdf).

Title: Inside the fight over Claude Mythos 5

URL Source: https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/950412/anthropic-trump-adminstration-claude-mythos-fable-5-export-controls

Published Time: 2026-06-16T03:00:00+00:00

Markdown Content:
As the rest of the country celebrated the USA’s first World Cup win and the New York Knicks championship, Anthropic spent its weekend fighting the Trump administration over its latest model release. At 5:21PM on Friday, the company received a US export control directive to suspend access to its Mythos 5 and Fable 5 AI models by “any foreign national” inside or outside the US, “including foreign national Anthropic employees.” The only way that was possible, Anthropic determined, was to completely [disable](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/949553/anthropic-fable-5-mythos-5-government-national-security) products it spent the [past week hyping](https://www.theverge.com/news/946725/anthropic-releases-claude-fable-5-mythos) — and travel to Washington, DC, in hopes of changing President Donald Trump’s mind. Now, over the coming days, the US government could dramatically alter the trajectory of the entire industry, dealing a major blow to American AI companies.

Claude Mythos 5 and Fable 5 are built on the same foundation as Anthropic’s Mythos Preview, which [Anthropic dubbed too dangerous](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/908114/anthropic-project-glasswing-cybersecurity) to publicly release. # Just the Docs: Eight States Sue OpenAI, Alleging It Misled the Public About ChatGPT’s Safety

By [Matthew Nagle](https://www.justsecurity.org/author/naglematthew/ "Profile and articles by Matthew Nagle")

Published on October 15, 2026

The attorneys general of[Arizona](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Arizona.pdf),[Arkansas](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Arkansas.pdf),[Idaho](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Idaho.pdf),[Iowa](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Iowa.pdf),[Kansas](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Kansas.pdf),[Montana](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Montana.pdf),[Nebraska](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Nebraska.pdf), and[West Virginia](https://www.justsecurity.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/West-Virginia.pdf) filed coordinated lawsuits against OpenAI in their own state courts on Oct. 14. The suits bring claims under state consumer protection laws, alleging that OpenAI marketed ChatGPT as safe while concealing its risks. They also present those risks as a threat to public safety.
